retrieved_knowledge.text: Denial of Service (single-source) attacks aim to exhaust a target's resources from one attacking host, rather than the many-source pattern of DDoS. Typical signatures: sustained high-rate traffic from a single source IP, often repetitive request patterns.

Port scanning is reconnaissance where an attacker probes a range of ports on a target host to discover open services before attempting exploitation. Typical signatures: many short flows to sequential or varied destination ports from a single source, very low or zero payload size, high connection attempt rate.
